cases.name: 3-huxley
cases.output:
Aldous Huxley wrote several science fiction novels, and these are the best known. Brave New World is his most famous, a dystopian story about a controlled future society. Island is his last novel, a utopian story about a remote island. Ape and Essence is a darker post-apocalyptic tale. Would you like to nominate one of these?
Books: Brave New World; Island; Ape and Essence
